_note: Held-out round 3 for bid-parse / bid-tech / bid-compliance, the last of this piece of work. Written 2026-09-20 with the rules frozen at commit ac0c428 and before any case was run; the exactly-once check is part of the generator this time. Axes the earlier rounds did not have: = / - / ｜ as separators, a thousands comma, 甲方 / 咱们 / 标书上, lots written 第1标段, a bracketed aside, several people in one request, an inline 招标：…｜我方：… row. First run 83/84 = 0.988 (0 misplaced, 0 dumped, 0 pasted cells); the one miss - a name given after a nickname, 「项目经理用老贾，贾国庆」 - drove a change, so this file counts as seen as well.
